_meta.description: Approved video segment registry. Every entry is a curated SEGMENT with timestamps, review metadata, and a mandatory no-video fallback. Candidates are NOT approved for sessions.
_meta.policy: No comments, autoplay, recommendations browsing, or arbitrary links during sessions. Never copy transcripts into the repo. Verify each segment immediately before use; YouTube availability changes.

segments.platformNotes: Must demonstrate touch OR controller OR mouse - verify before approval
segments.commentsHandling: Playback via mentor screen-share only; comments hidden/closed; autoplay off

fallback.description: Mentor builds a tiny house live in under 4 minutes while narrating each step; same remix step applies.

segments.note: CANDIDATE ONLY. A specific, currently-available Bedrock-compatible beginner build segment must be located and verified (URL live, timestamps exact, controls match Bedrock, captions available, no sponsor read, child-safe comments area). Do not use in sessions until status becomes approved.
